# requires: logging
#
# Record content is data. Each line below puts text that some logging library
# once expanded, formatted or executed into the message, the job and an
# attribute, then reads the record back. A binding that resolves a lookup,
# fills a format directive or runs a substitution returns different bytes.
record R 0
text R ${jndi:ldap://x/a}
text R ${${lower:j}ndi:ldap://x/a}
text R %n%s%x
text R {0}{}
text R $(id)
text R `id`
text R #{7*7}

# expect 4: ok same=yes [LOG-R9]
# expect 5: ok same=yes [LOG-R9]
